summary: @apexfdn/apex install script collects host and environment data
details: install.cjs runs at npm install time (preinstall/install/postinstall lifecycle) and imports `os` and `https`, reads `process.env` and `process.platform`, and issues an outbound HTTPS request. The pattern of gathering OS/platform identifiers plus environment variables and transmitting them over HTTPS at install time is characteristic of installer-side reconnaissance and environment-variable exfiltration, which routinely captures secrets such as CI tokens, npm auth tokens, and cloud credentials present in the environment of a developer or build machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
